weapon.d: Effective against armored foes. Grants Atk+3. If it is an odd-numbered turn or if foe's HP < 100% at start of combat, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4 to unit during combat.

b.d: If it is an odd-numbered turn and unit's HP = 100%, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack and foe cannot make a follow-up attack.
If it is an odd-numbered turn and unit's HP ≥ 50%, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack and foe cannot make a follow-up attack.

builds.name: Festival Marquess Vanguard
builds.desc: There isn't a whole lot you can do to improve a Hector unit, so you'll notice there's not much different. Dragon Fang/Draconic Aura utilises his incredibly high Atk stat, whilst Savage Blow helps him proc his weapon's skill. Pivot lets Hector get closer to enemies, and the Fort. Def/Res seal makes it so you hardly have to worry about getting him out of harm's way.
